plan.summary: Wrap os.fchmod() in hasattr/try-except to handle Windows compatibility

implementation_sequence.action: Create failing regression test that mocks Windows environment where os.fchmod raises AttributeError
Implement fix: wrap os.fchmod in hasattr check or try/except AttributeError
Run tests to verify fix passes
Run existing permission tests to ensure Unix behavior preserved
Run linter to ensure code quality

verification_commands: uv run pytest tests/test_issue_5971_windows_fchmod.py tests/test_issue_2027_permissions.py tests/test_storage_atomicity.py -v

acceptance_criteria: save() works on Windows without AttributeError
Temp file permissions remain 0o600 on Unix
risks: Windows temp file permissions may be less restrictive than Unix - this is acceptable as Windows has different security model

implementation_summary.fix_description: Wrapped os.fchmod() call with contextlib.suppress(AttributeError) to gracefully handle Windows where the function doesn't exist. tempfile.mkstemp already creates files with secure defaults on Windows.
